structural_change: CB16c-COLL2-SR 10-22 (ALT, STEWARD-QKc/SQC-CB16c): body of the regionally split S2 collective face qfd_coll_face_cx (RTL qfd_coll_static_face_x, generated by exact substitution from the face RTL at 2919e5896). The four pin-bound ranks moved to hardened edge slices with their own clock entries (tx_data td_q, rx CDC o_data: 0 cycles; phy_tx / phy_rx: +1 each, consumed by the calendar, face L+2). Geometry = qfd_coll_face_s0_regional7_main (6 macros, 12 roots, ten landing bands) on an 864.0 x 907.2 outline (E band moved in 43.2 um), with every bus pin CLUSTERED in the window of its owning band, so each root's pin flops are within one ~250-um band (was: tx_data / rx_data / phy pins spread over the whole 907-um edge on one root). COLLIO-SR2 10-23: SEAM landing sub-bands (RTL and cycles unchanged): bank landing din_q/wa_q/we_q, codec_data/codec_valid and tx o_valid placed in centre seams (ALT, +59.4 um east) of their own roots, so no inter-entry hop exceeds ~650 um (all 5 body gates failed cross_clock on 600-1200-um crossings).
